cache.policy: Source files never enter Git. The cache lives under build/, which is already ignored. Nothing touches ~/.sword or any user module.

provenance_notes: Volume-level metadata comes from HathiTrust MARC records, which carry the edition statement, imprint, collation and the 'Texto en latín y español' note. Volume 3 was read from the title page of the digitised object itself.
Volume 2 could not be identified from any authoritative source reachable in this session. Its fields are null on purpose.

The BNE identifier bdh0000014290 was recorded by the previous task against Biblioteca Digital Hispánica. BDH was replaced by BNE Digital in Oct/Nov 2025 and the whole *.bne.es domain answered 403 here, so neither the identifier nor its rights page could be re-verified in this session.
No checksum in this manifest was computed from anything other than the exact file it names.
Volume 6 carries no biblical text. The manifest says so with corpus_role, so a missing volume 6 never reads as an incomplete Bible.

Every witness carries a role. Only a distributable_primary witness (BNE) may produce the release artifact; the Google-digitised volume 3 is a development_witness and is marked as forbidden for release, so it cannot become the shipped TorresAmat1835 by accident.
